declared_outcome_interpretations.efficiency_only: token savings reported per arm as efficiency, by construction never as capability
declared_outcome_interpretations.h0_consistent: positive r with CI excluding 0 -> H13 refuted; compression must be treated as a candidate capability lever in later designs
declared_outcome_interpretations.null_result: not applicable: a flat correlation is the confirmatory outcome here
declared_outcome_interpretations.positive: |r| <= 0.1 with CI including 0 -> H13 supported: compression and capability decouple

minimum_interesting_effect.note: H13 (compression is not capability), designed on the vericoding template: natural-language descriptions add nothing, the loop adds everything. Hold the K0 verifier loop fixed, vary only compressibility.
